title: Anderson Platinum vs Our Wealth Plan
h1: Anderson Platinum vs our wealth plan
keyLine: One is attorney access. Ours is a 12-month written order. Tax filing is a third bill.
description: Anderson Platinum compared with Legacy Wealth Blueprint: attorney membership vs a written wealth plan. Public Platinum price. We do not print our tuition.
query: Anderson Platinum vs Legacy Wealth Blueprint
answer: Anderson Platinum is a legal, tax, and asset protection membership. Their page listed $3,495 to enroll plus $75 a month on September 15, 2026. It sells attorney access and document review. Their FAQ said tax filing packages are not included. Legacy Wealth Blueprint is Preston Seo's 12-month wealth plan: a written snapshot from your numbers, a guide, weekly coaching, and a CPA brief. You keep your CPA. We do not publish our tuition here. Use Platinum when you already have entities and constant legal questions. Use us when you want tax, debt, and investing in one order. Hire a CPA when you need a signed Form 1040.

blocks.heading: What we actually sell
paragraphs: [Preston Seo](/about) built Legacy Investing Show after a corporate job and a $15M+ portfolio with his wife. [Blueprint](/legacy-wealth-blueprint) is the 12-month plan from that work: tax, debt, income, investing, and protection in one written order. It is education and coaching. It is not a law firm.
Anderson Platinum is a different job: attorneys and documents on tap. A cheap tax video is a third job. Do not buy all three unless you can name why.

blocks.heading: What Anderson Platinum is
paragraphs: The [Platinum membership page](https://andersonadvisors.com/platinum-membership/) we opened on September 15, 2026 listed $3,495 enrollment plus $75 a month. It advertises unlimited strategy sessions, attorney-reviewed documents, a template library, and a live Q and A room. Treat feature lists as seller copy. We are not members for this briefing.
Their FAQ on that same page said tax packages are not included in Platinum. You can still ask tax questions in office hours. Filing is a separate product.

blocks.heading: Where a tax class sits
paragraphs: A tax course is lessons. [WealthAbility Live](https://www.wealthability.com/wealthability-live/) is a public example at $197 a month. That is still not Blueprint, and it is not Platinum. If you want a named list of other classes, use [best tax strategy programs for W-2 earners over $250k](/blog/best-tax-strategy-programs-w2-earners-over-250k). This URL will not paste that table.
If the job is class vs filer, read [tax course vs a CPA](/compare/tax-course-vs-cpa).

blocks.label: Three bills, not one
paragraphs: People buy Platinum and think the return is filed. People buy a class and think an attorney will review the lease. People buy Blueprint and think we sign Form 1040. Budget membership, plan, and preparer as separate lines, then drop the ones you do not need.

faqs.q: Does Anderson Platinum include tax filing?
